name: Adjustable angle head
summary: Orient an ER25 tool to the required machining angle with a compact ISO30 aggregate. Drilling and saw configurations support angled access without rebuilding the machine.
paragraphs: The AD-ISO30-ER25 couples to a ISO30 spindle and provides an adjustable output axis for access to inclined faces and side features.
Set the required angle with the machine stopped, then secure the locking components before operation. Match the tool, speed and clearance to the intended drilling or sawing configuration.
dataNotes: Specifications supplied by the project owner; the linked HQD detail page was unavailable during collection.

name: Dual-output angle head
summary: Two ER25 output positions extend the working envelope of a HSK63F spindle. A 1:1.43 transmission supports up to 12,000 rpm at the output.
paragraphs: The HSK63F-ER25×2 offers two tool positions from one HSK63F input, reducing the need to reposition the workpiece between accessible faces.
The stated input speed is 8,400 rpm and the maximum output is 12,000 rpm. The head uses grease lubrication and a compact housing for installation where clearance is limited.
sourceTitle: HQD HSK63F Dual-Output Angle Head with ER25 Collets HSK63F-ER25×2

name: Dual-output head with saw mount
summary: Combine ER25 tooling and a saw-mount option in a HSK63F aggregate. Select the active machining configuration to suit drilling, milling or cutting access.
paragraphs: The HSK63F-ER25×2-S connects to a HSK63F spindle and provides an ER25 tool interface with a saw-blade mounting option.
Use the speed limits assigned to the installed tool configuration. Confirm the mounting arrangement, machine clearance and permitted operating sequence with the application team.

name: Four-output angle head
summary: Four ER25 outputs combine multiple tool positions in one HSK63F aggregate. The speed-increasing transmission reaches a stated 12,000 rpm output from 8,400 rpm input.
paragraphs: The HSK63F-ER25×4 brings four ER25 tool positions together in a compact HSK63F head for multi-face work.
Its shared input drives the output shafts through a 1:1.43 transmission. A compact body and grease lubrication simplify integration and routine maintenance.

name: Fixed 45° angle head
summary: A fixed 45° output brings angled drilling and sawing to an ISO30 spindle. The ER25 interface and saw mount cover complementary machining tasks.
paragraphs: A dedicated 45° geometry provides consistent access to inclined features without resetting the angle between parts.
The published table specifies a 1:1 ratio, ER25 tooling, a maximum Ø16 mm bit and a maximum Ø180 mm saw blade. Drilling and sawing have different speed limits.
